name: Gettyia
sum: Small avisaurid enantiornithean from the Campanian Two Medicine Formation of Montana known from one foot bone.
holotype: A right tarsometatarsus found by volunteer collector Gloria Siebrecht (Museum of the Rockies).
biology: Foot anatomy suggests forceful toe flexion, as used by birds of prey in hunting (Atterholt et al. 2018).
author: Atterholt et al. 2018

sources.text: Atterholt, Jessie; Hutchison, J. Howard; O'Connor, Jingmai K. 2018. The most complete enantiornithine from North America and a phylogenetic analysis of the Avisauridae. PeerJ 6. doi:10.7717/peerj.5910
